state_machine.meaning: Occupancy is absent or Night is selected; fan is off and the delay is reset.
The fan is waiting while the timer Q is false and running while Q is true.

timer_plan.name: FAN_START_DELAY
timer_plan.reset_conditions: Call with IN = FALSE on occupancy loss or selection of Night; initialize the instance reset at power-up.
timer_plan.timing: The first permitted call starts at elapsed zero. Q becomes true on the first call at or after 30 seconds of continuously sampled permit. Switching among Auto, Comfort and Economy does not reset the timer.

priorities: Occupancy loss or Night stops the fan and resets the timer in the same observed scan.
Night temperature adjustment overrides occupancy and energy-saving selection.
Energy-saving selection affects only unoccupied Auto adjustment.
Temperature adjustment is independent of the fan delay and is bounded to -4 through +4 degrees Celsius.

initial_values.scope: Fresh instance, before the first invocation

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Snapshot all inputs. Compute permit as OCCUPANCY_DETECTED AND HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR <> 3. Derive rising and falling permit edges from previous_permit, then update previous_permit. Edges are observational; timer control uses the permit level.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: If permit is false, select BLOCKED; otherwise select PERMITTED. This transition takes effect in the current scan. Do not use a previous-scan timer Q to decide the fan output.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: Call FAN_START_DELAY exactly once with IN := permit and PT := T#30s. Its current-call Q and reset are available to stage 4.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign SUPPLY_FAN_RUN := permit AND FAN_START_DELAY.Q. Calculate TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST from the sampled inputs: Night = 4; otherwise occupied = 0; otherwise Auto = 3 if energy saving is true or 2 if false, Comfort = 1, Economy = 4. Clamp the result to [-4, 4]. Calculate outputs on the first invocation as well.

formal_assertions.formula: G((HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR = 0 AND NOT OCCUPANCY_DETECTED AND ENERGY_SAVING_MODE) -> (TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST = 3))
G((HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR = 0 AND NOT OCCUPANCY_DETECTED AND NOT ENERGY_SAVING_MODE) -> (TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST = 2))
